name: Nestle S.A.

corporate_actions.event: CEO Mark Schneider replaced by Laurent Freixe
CEO Laurent Freixe dismissed (undisclosed relationship with subordinate); Philipp Navratil appointed CEO; Chair Paul Bulcke stepped down early, Pablo Isla Chair
Strategic update: focus on Coffee, Petcare, Nutrition (~70% of sales) + regional Food & Snacks; ice cream remainder to Froneri (advanced negotiations); mainstream VMS for sale
Waters & premium beverages into 50:50 JV 'Peranel' with Platinum Equity (EV EUR4.9bn, ~CHF2.8bn net cash H1-2027); VMS & ice cream classified held for sale; CHF1.3bn non-cash write-down

geography.fx_notes: CHF reporter; FX -5.7% on 2025 reported sales, -6.2% in H1-2026. Zone split not retrieved this session (zones reorganised into Americas/Europe/AOA in 2025). US is largest market; Greater China small single-digit % and 'now stable' (S2). Exact % not verified -> null.

kpis.name: Fuel for Growth savings
kpis.value: CHF1.7bn cumulative; target CHF3.0bn by end-2027

company_fcf.definition: Company FCF (OCF - capex incl. intangibles - lease payments per Nestle definition)

lease.notes: not retrieved this session; methodology lease proxy applies

acquisitions.notes: Acquired remaining 51% of yfood; divested Blue Bottle Coffee; amounts not retrieved

management.senior_turnover_5y: High: three CEOs between Aug-2024 and Sep-2025 (Schneider->Freixe->Navratil); Chair Bulcke replaced by Pablo Isla (Oct-2025)
management.succession_notes: Freixe dismissal followed internal investigation; board renewal under new Chair
management.guidance_record: Mixed-to-weak: medium-term targets withdrawn/cut in 2024; 2025 OG 3.5% met updated guidance; 2026 OG 3-4% reaffirmed at 9M

ownership.board_independence: Majority independent (standard Swiss governance; not re-verified)
ownership.related_party: Holds ~20% of L'Oreal (equity-accounted); no related-party abuse identified

evidence: Consumables across coffee, petcare, nutrition, food (S1)
A.rationale: Highly repeat, consumable demand with diversified customers.

evidence: But RIG negative 2023 and share losses 2024 (S1)
B.rationale: Strong brands (Nescafe, Nespresso, Purina) with proven pricing power, though volume elasticity showed in 2023-24.

evidence: UTOP margin 16.1% vs food peers mid-teens (S1)
C.rationale: Global procurement/R&D scale supports above-food-peer margins, but margins fell 110bp in 2025.

evidence: Food & Snacks and Nutrition low growth; coffee growth price-led (S2)
D.rationale: Mature categories with low volume runway; growth platforms only ~30% of sales.

evidence: Sales in 185 countries; EM grew 5.6% in H1-26 (S2)
E.rationale: Broad global spread, no country >40% (US largest), with meaningful EM/FX exposure.

F.rationale: Disorderly leadership turnover outweighs early execution signs under Navratil.

evidence: Net debt rose to CHF56bn (2024) partly via buybacks before deleveraging (S1)
CHF1.3bn write-down on assets held for sale (S2)
G.rationale: History of value-destroying M&A/write-downs and leverage creep; now simplifying portfolio.

H.rationale: Standard governance; culture/oversight questions raised by 2025 CEO dismissal.

I3.rationale: Large SG&A base offers some AI/automation productivity scope.

evidence: Retailer bargaining limits retention of cost savings (INFERENCE)
I4.rationale: Mixed: savings likely partly reinvested/competed away.

evidence: Coffee pricing 4.7% in H1-26 reflects green coffee inflation (S2)
J.rationale: Partial pass-through with lags; commodity and recall exposure.

evidence: Reported net profit CHF9.0bn vs underlying CHF11.4bn-equivalent EPS gap (S1)
K.rationale: Clean audit, but sizeable recurring non-underlying items; FCF ~ net income.

ai.notes: No AI/data-centre or semis revenue (business description, S4); 0 here is a FACT-based inference from business mix, not a missing value.

sector_specific.private_label_risk: Medium: European/US food and frozen face private label; coffee (Nespresso/Nescafe) and premium petcare more insulated (INFERENCE)
sector_specific.glp1_risk: Moderate for confectionery, frozen and snacks; Nestle positions Health Science/Vital Pursuit as offset (INFERENCE)
sector_specific.china_note: Greater China small, inventory reset done, 'now stable' (S2)

gates.notes: G1 B: company net debt/adj. EBITDA 2.85x at Dec-2025 (S1), but PitchBook TTM 2Q2026 net debt/EBITDA ~3.96x (EBITDA depressed by CHF1.3bn write-down; mid-year net debt seasonally high) - above 3.5x staples threshold on provider basis; credible deleveraging path via waters JV proceeds (~CHF2.8bn H1-2027) -> B, needs lease-adjusted check. G2: infant formula recall is product, not accounting. G4: FCF CHF9.2bn vs net profit CHF9.0bn (2025). G6: disposals (waters JV, ice cream, mainstream VMS) are material but not transaction-dominated. G7: UK consumer exposure small.

bull_points: Category leadership in coffee and petcare with pricing power; RIG recovering to 2.8% in Q3-2026 (S3)
Self-help: Fuel for Growth CHF3bn savings by 2027 and portfolio simplification (S2)
Deleveraging from waters JV proceeds (~CHF2.8bn) and disposals (S2)
bear_points: Disorderly leadership turnover (3 CEOs in 13 months) and culture/oversight questions (S5)
Growth 2022-23 was almost entirely price; volumes flat-to-negative and margins fell 110bp in 2025 (S1,S6)
Leverage elevated (2.85x) with FCF down 14% in 2025; GLP-1 and private label pressure on food/confectionery volumes
thesis_breakers: Net debt/EBITDA above 3.5x without disposal proceeds
UTOP margin below 15.5% in FY2026 or FY2027
